name: NGC 136 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 136, an open cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc136-hubble
story: Here Hubble studies its own eye. The stars of the open cluster NGC 136 show how the telescope spreads a point of light, a model the astronomers need to find faint Einstein rings hidden in the glare of lensing quasars.

claims.text: Program 17710 observed NGC 136 to measure Hubble's point spread function (PSF) across stars of different spectral types
The PSF model supports a search for faint Einstein rings hidden in the glare of lensing quasars
